create_better_networking.configuration.s: Show the network ID in the clipboard highlight HUD when the network has no name
create_better_networking.frequency.contr: Shift-left-click to copy; left-click to paste. To name a network, add a clipboard entry containing only #network: Link Series.
create_better_networking.frequency.empty: No frequency saved. Shift-left-click a linked block to copy one.
create_better_networking.frequency.inact: That factory gauge panel is inactive
create_better_networking.frequency.prote: You do not have permission to change that network
create_better_networking.frequency.same: That block already uses this frequency
create_better_networking.frequency.clien: Client only: Shift-left-click to select; Shift-left-click air to clear. Selection lasts until disconnect.
create_better_networking.frequency.serve: Applying networks requires Better Networking on the server.
